subject: Ephemeral testcase transfer — commitments & close cadence
messages:
From: Ava Retail Ops <ops@avaretail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Kara Jensen <kara.jensen@avaretail.com>, procurement@avaretail.com
Date: 2026-11-29T15:03:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP draft — testcases & access window

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the MAP draft. Before we lock in the timeline we need two quick confirmations from Redwood:

1) Ephemeral access window — we asked for a 30-day sandbox with automatic deletion at day 31. Does Redwood's staging environment support automated snapshot destruction (no manual steps) and can you provide an audit log for all ingestion/access?

2) Usage constraints — the eval suite includes PII-like synthetic records. We need a short acceptable-use bullet list to include in our procurement packet that maps to our security questionnaire (we'll attach the relevant section).

We're aiming to sign the MPA and exchange the prompt pack+testcases by next Tuesday 2026-12-01 so the engineering sprint can start 2026-12-06. Can Redwood confirm?

Kara Jensen
Director, Ops — Ava Retail
(attachment: ava_security_section.pdf)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Ava Retail Ops <ops@avaretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T18:12:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP draft — testcases & access window

Kara — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front: yes on automated destruction + audit logs; yes on a concise acceptable-use list. Details below and an updated close cadence.

High-level commitments (what we'll put into the MAP):
- Sandbox window: 30 calendar days from first ingest; automated snapshot + object-store purge at UTC 00:00 on day 31.
- Audit logs: generation of an ingestion/access audit bundle (TLS-backed), delivered as a read-only link and retained for 90 days per the MAP.
- Usage constraints (short bullets for procurement): do not export promptpack contents outside of the agreed team; do not use materials to train external models; no public distribution; keep access to named engineers only.

Operational timeline (proposed):
- 2026-12-01: Signed MPA + NDA + prompt pack/testcases uploaded to staging (Redwood).
- 2026-12-02 — 2026-12-05: Access provisioning & smoke tests (Ava to confirm two engineers).
- 2026-12-06: Sprint starts.

I've cc'd Karthik and Marcus for the infra/rotation details; Ben will handle commercial language. I'll upload the updated MAP and a short one-page acceptable-use snippet to Drive and share the link.

Naomi Feldman
Head, Partner GTM — Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_map_v2.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ava Retail Ops <ops@avaretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP draft — testcases & access window

Kara / Naomi — looping in Laura (legal) for final procurement language. A few commercial points to confirm before signatures:
- Limited use license: confirm Ava is ok with "ephemeral evaluation only" license (no derivative redistribution).
- Data destruction confirmation: Redwood will provide an automated deletion certificate (timestamped) + the 90-day audit log snapshot.
- Liability carveouts: we'll keep standard indemnity language but will add a limited SLA credit clause if automated destruction fails.

Kara — small ask: can procurement send us the finalized PO number and whether Ava requires a SOW? We will mirror whatever you need in the MPA.

Ben Carter
Commercial Lead — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ava Retail Ops <ops@avaretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T15:22:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP draft — testcases & access window

Kara / team — technical clarifications from infra: we will provision an ephemeral bucket in our staging VPC with the following controls:
- Access tokens scoped to the two named engineers, rotated daily if requested (we can do 24h rotation for extra assurance).
- Auto-delete job runs at UTC 00:00 on day 31 and removes objects + KV caches; we also zero out any persisted embeddings derived during the eval.
- Audit bundle will include: ingestion timestamp, object checksums, IP of retrievals, and an action log for delete job.

Two small notes:
1) If Ava needs on-prem destruction evidence (HSM logs), we can provide attestations but that'll add 1 business day to the handoff.
2) For PII-like synthetic records, we recommend the testcases_manifest.csv include a column labeled "synthetic_flag" so both sides can track which items require additional handling. I'll add that to the staging manifest.

Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ava Retail Ops <ops@avaretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T08:43:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP draft — testcases & access window

Quick addition on retention/destruction: our deletion certificate will contain the object manifests (SHA256) and the run log from the purge job. We'll keep the run log internally for 90 days and provide a redacted copy for procurement. If Ava needs full verbatim logs for audit, please state that now — otherwise we'll default to the redacted certificate.

Also: we can include a one-click revocation button in the console for the lifetime of the sandbox (in case you need immediate takedown).

Marcus Lin
Product — Infrastructure Controls

From: Kara Jensen <kara.jensen@avaretail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@avaretail.com
Date: 2026-12-01T10:12:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP draft — testcases & access window

Naomi / team — this all sounds good and matches our internal security packet. Procurement has attached the signed NDA and the PO number in the thread (see attached). We confirm the two engineers: lucas.p@avaretail.com and me (kara.jensen@avaretail.com).

We accept the ephemeral evaluation-only license and the redacted deletion certificate is sufficient for our procurement intake. Please proceed with upload and share the staging link + Drive folder.

Attached: NDA_avaretail_signed.pdf, PO_4583.pdf, promptpack_request_list.xlsx

Kara Jensen
Director, Ops — Ava Retail
